name: value-train-10k
architecture: MLP 40 -> 128 -> 128 -> 1 (ReLU), sigmoid output, BCE to the game outcome; one model per sampling point

gate.metric: test AUC (seat's eventual win) of the network minus the better of the served leaf AUC and the served shared-score AUC, per point
gate.pass: game-clustered bootstrap 95% lower bound of the gain > 0 at every point

note: Predeclared 2026-11-04 before the 10k test split (seeds 2649000-2649999) is read (Jerry: retrain on the 10k value data). Prediction only, not a strength claim. Reference, not a bar: the pv-v1 v head reached AUC .728 on its own test games (turn-start rows, 1,000-game data). Epoch chosen by loss on the last 500 train games; no other tuning. A pass makes the end_turn model the candidate leaf for a predeclared short-lookahead search screen.
